defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Mode selection dumped the player back on Home
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: index.html gave #player-names-modal, #games-library-modal and #game-record-modal an inline style="display:none". show*Modal() only added an .active class, which sets opacity and pointer-events but cannot override an inline display. The dialog never rendered.
defectsFoundAndFixed.impact: Starting ANY mode failed on the first attempt; Games library and record/replay were unreachable.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Visibility is class-driven only. No app code sets element.style.display. E2E asserts no dialog/overlay/screen carries an inline display.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Red army generated with a duplicated piece and only one bomb
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: generateLegalSetup swapped a front-row bomb with army[findIndex(non-bomb)], which for the red side always resolved to an already-placed index. The same piece object was written to two stations and one bomb was dropped.
defectsFoundAndFixed.impact: 100% of red formations over 2000 trials. Red is the computer's army in Vs Computer and Player 2's army in Classic, so every game had an illegal opposing formation.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Constraint-first generation: Flag, then Mines, then the front row from the non-bomb pool. validateFormation() asserts 25 unique pieces and full legality; 400-iteration test per side.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Replay was a counter, not a replay
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: Step Back / Forward / Play only incremented a label. No position was ever reconstructed.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Records store openingBoard; positions are rebuilt from opening + public history. Stepping is verified to change the rendered board and to leave the stored record untouched.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Every app launch created and saved a junk game
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: JunqiBoard's constructor called startNewGame('vs_computer'), which called saveState(). With a 20-game cap, roughly twenty launches would evict the owner's real games.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Records are written only when a player actually starts a game. E2E asserts navigating does not add rows.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: AI information boundary leaked piece identity through the id
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: createAiObservation redacted name and rank but passed id through unchanged — ids are of the form 'navy-司令-0'.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Unknown pieces are reduced to an opaque token. Test asserts no rank character appears in any redacted field.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Board movement did not match the drawn board
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: Any orthogonally adjacent step was legal, so pieces crossed the front line at columns 1 and 3 where no line is drawn. Rows 0 and 11 were marked as railway, allowing rail runs along the Headquarters rows.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: An explicit adjacency graph; the drawn SVG is generated from the same graph, so board and rules cannot diverge.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Game-over Home button threw
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: board.js called this.app.showSurface('home'); AppController only defines switchSurface. TypeError on every use.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Single state machine; no such method call exists. Covered by the end-card E2E test.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: No stalemate handling
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: A player with no legal move was never detected, so the game simply stopped.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: endTurn() checks flag presence and legal-move availability; loss by immobility is a real outcome.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Move animation frequently did not run
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: The transition property and the target transform were assigned in the same rAF callback, so the browser could coalesce them into a jump with no interpolation.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Web Animations API with explicit keyframes, plus a hard timeout so presentation can never block game logic.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: App icon was a 1499x925 transparent PNG declared as 192x192 and 512x512
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: The OS scaled a 1.62:1 image into a square, which is the stretching the owner observed. purpose was 'any maskable' with no safe-zone padding.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Square masters generated from the mark with its aspect ratio preserved exactly; separate maskable variant with a 40% mark.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Service worker version skew
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: Navigation was network-first while code was served stale-while-revalidate, so a fresh index.html could be paired with a previous build's JS and CSS.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Code and styles are network-first with a 2.5s timeout and cache fallback.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Setup state was persisted but its baseline was not
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: saveActiveGame never wrote initialSetupSessionState, so Reset silently did nothing after a reload.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: setupBaseline is part of the record.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Reveal in Flip mode was not turn-gated
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: Two rapid taps could turn over two pieces in one turn.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: The reveal holds the input gate until the turn has changed hands.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Replay of a Vs Computer record concealed the human's own army
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: Spectator seat resolved to 'red', concealing everything including pieces the human had always seen.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Spectator visibility is explicit; Vs Computer records show the human's own army, two-player records stay fully concealed.

e2eTests.note: Every assertion is made against rendered state — element boxes, computed styles, rendered text — not against object state.

notVerifiedHere: Physical iPad hardware: touch accuracy, Home Screen icon rendering, real audio output, true offline launch from the Home Screen. Requires the owner's 2-minute acceptance pass.
Safari-specific rendering. The automated runs used Chromium 150; the CSS avoids Chromium-only features, but Safari has not been exercised directly.
